consumer: An external combat-log analysis script reading the JSON export, asking each monster's raw current HP integer.
scope: Per-exported-monster raw current/max HP integers as authoritative world state, not a filtered or bucketed view.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) writes mon.get_hp()/mon.get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters into the JSON.
divergence: A monster the player cannot currently see, where a GUI health-band/remembered-display proxy would report a coarse or lagged value while the raw getter still yields exact HP; the raw getter is what the log script needs.
